summary.one_liner: A context-engineering and spec-driven development framework that guides AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor through a phased discuss-plan-execute-verify-ship loop.
summary.what_it_does: GSD Core is a set of prompts, commands, and tooling that drives AI coding agents through a repeated five-step loop per phase: discuss, plan, execute, verify, and ship. Heavy research, planning, and execution run in fresh-context subagents so the main session stays lean and output quality does not degrade as the context window fills. Structured artifacts such as STATE.md and CONTEXT.md are kept across sessions as shared memory. The verify step walks through what was built and generates fix plans before a phase is marked done. An npx installer targets multiple runtimes, including Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and Windsurf, and can install globally or locally. The README also indexes tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation docs.
use_cases: structuring a new software project with an AI coding agent
onboarding an existing codebase for AI-assisted development
running multi-step feature work in phases with verification
keeping AI agent sessions from losing quality as context grows
generating plans and fix plans for AI-written code
setting up one shared workflow across several AI coding tools
notable: Runs heavy research, planning, and execution in fresh-context subagents to avoid context rot
Installer supports many AI coding runtimes and global or local install
Plans are executed in parallel waves, each executor starting with a clean context
Persistent artifacts (STATE.md, CONTEXT.md) carry memory across sessions
Documentation organized by tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation, with multiple languages
caveats: Requires Node.js for the default installer; other runtimes need the install guide in the docs
The README says not to copy files from agents/ or commands/ directly; the installer is required for cross-runtime compatibility
Opinionated five-step workflow may be heavy for very small one-off tasks (inferred)
